annotation.title_clean: National AI Strategy (NAIS) 2.0 Update: Refreshed Priorities across the Enablers
annotation.title_en: National AI Strategy (NAIS) 2.0 Update: Refreshed Priorities across the Enablers
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI), Government of Singapore
annotation.summary_en: Singapore's May 2026 update to its National AI Strategy 2.0 refreshes priorities across ten enablers: national AI Missions, public sector adoption, research, talent, compute, data, trusted environment and international leadership. Embodied AI appears only in passing as a research area. Governance is layered, voluntary and sectoral, with horizontal AI legislation under assessment.
key_provisions_or_claims: Launch national AI Missions in advanced manufacturing, financial services, connectivity and healthcare.
Commit over S$1 billion to public AI research 2025-2030, including AI Research Centres of Excellence covering embodied and physical AI.
Continue layered AI governance via voluntary frameworks and sector regulators, while assessing the need for horizontal AI legislation.
Strengthen AI testing and assurance through AI Verify, the Global AI Assurance Sandbox and ISO/IEC 42119-8 co-development.
Train 100,000 workers to be AI bilingual and expand compute through ASPIRE 2B and a Digital Infrastructure Act.
